items.definition:
a tunnel carrying a stream or open drain under a road or railroad
The water flowed freely through the culvert beneath the road.

a non-interactive sequence in a video game
The game features impressive cutscenes that advance the story.

the quality of being trustworthy and reliable
His dependability makes him an excellent team member.

a company that conducts most of its business on the internet
Many dotcom companies emerged during the internet boom of the late 1990s.

young newt
The eft, a juvenile newt, can live on land before returning to water.

the leaf or leaflike part of a palm, fern, or similar plant
The fern unfurled a new frond in the spring.

A heavily armed aircraft or vessel
The gunship provided air support for the ground troops.

A device used for measuring or maintaining orientation and angular velocity
A smartphone uses a gyroscope to detect its orientation.

An event where computer programmers and others collaborate intensively on software projects
Our team won first prize at the annual hackathon.

One's deepest feelings of love or compassion (usually plural)
The sad movie really tugged at my heartstrings.

Text with hyperlinks to other text or media
The internet is built on the concept of hypertext.
